title: Simulated tumour microenvironment — untreated
description: A 2,400-cell simulated section with an irregular tumour mass, an invasive margin rich in immune cells, surrounding stroma and seven vessels. The tumour core sits furthest from any vessel and carries the strongest hypoxic signalling. Tumour, fibroblast, macrophage, T-cell and endothelial compartments each express a different part of the panel.
simulationNotice: SIMULATED TISSUE. This section was generated by the spatial-omics-engine tissue model, not measured. Cells were placed by Poisson-disc rejection into a tumour core, periphery, invasive margin and stroma; cell-type identity sets which network nodes each cell can express; hypoxia enters as a sustained drive on HIF1A from vessel distance; and a curated 64-node intracellular network coupled by diffusible ligands was relaxed to a steady state. Counts are negative-binomial draws from that state. Every result computed on this case is a statement about that model and about nothing else.
